title: Regulations & Digital Accessibility
excerpt: In a world where inclusion and accessibility are becoming societal priorities, the law on the accessibility of products and services, adopted on March 8, 2023, represents a major step towards a more equitable society. Scheduled to come into force on June 28, 2025, these regulations offer companies an opportunity to modernize their practices while meeting the needs of all users, without exception.
description: Interview with Julien Desmulier in the February 2025 issue of D'HANDWIERK magazine on the subject of digital accessibility.
